not_run.reason: GARS admits only sequencing reads. stage00_register.py's RAW_SUFFIXES is (.fastq.gz, .fq.gz, .fastq, .fq), applied in find_raw() before anything else, and workspace.py's INPUT_KINDS is a closed two-entry set (fastq, sample_dir) whose files_header() raises on anything else. No verb anywhere in the deterministic core registers an artifact that a sub-stage did not produce: resolve_artifact.py only scans the OUTPUTS.tsv of COMPLETE sub-stages under 02_bioinformatics/<assay>/. The planted-effect fixture is a counts matrix, so the project cannot be created at all, and the differential-expression sub-stage is never reached.
